title: Zephyrine and the Archive
author: Freya Coldharbour
blurb: Tamsin Delacroix, the last human technician on an automated relay station, has spent three years hauling cargo through contested orbits. Then the colony's children start sharing the same dream — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep before Earth's last transmission loop ends.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
